> [!NOTE]
> 🤖 **Claude Opus 5.5 responding on behalf of Cristian Sotomayor**

Answering the github-actions review summary, on #471 (top of the stack):

- **Ready cards are retired when the user leaves the Library even if list view or a filter kept them from being shown**: fixed in [`7f28eb97`](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/commit/7f28eb978e3d558381c6d63de188fb09ef2db65f). The Library notes which cards the grid showed, and only those retire.

The pullfrog findings (the pill's name, Show in Finder / drag not counting as seen, the Email tag) are answered in their inline threads.

> [!NOTE]
> 🤖 **Claude Opus 5.5 responding on behalf of Cristian Sotomayor**

Merged `main` up the stack. Main now fingerprints a whole-recording copy of a take with a webcam as `whole:<face hash>` (NIW2-576), so comparing against `"whole"` dropped those copies' destination. 84b1fe55 makes `copyPresetOf` use `isWholeFingerprint` and adds a test. The same fix landed in `master-copies-panel` (0f0896c0), `export-runner`'s `wholeRecording` (0f0896c0), and the Export screen's "Ready" lookup, which now uses `prepareFingerprint` (89dabc7b).
